translationRepairs: He immediately sent out his generals with two hundred twenty thousand men, drawing up battle lines outside the nine gates: Tao Jin at Anding, Liu An at Dongzhi, Zhu Ying at Chaoyang, Liu Ju at Xizhi, Gu Xingzu at Fucheng, Li Duan at Zhengyang, Liu Dexin at Chongwen, Tang Jie at Xuanwu—while Qian himself, with Shi Heng, Fan Guang, and Chen De, took position outside Desheng Gate to meet Esen head-on.

He immediately sent out his generals with two hundred twenty thousand men, drawing up battle lines outside the nine gates: Tao Jin at Anding, Liu An at Dongzhi, Zhu Ying at Chaoyang, Liu Ju at Xizhi, Gu Xingzu at Fucheng, Li Duan at Zhengyang, Liu Dexin at Chongwen, Tang Jie at Xuanwu—while Qian himself, with Shi Heng, led Vice Commanders Fan Guang and Wu Xing, arrayed outside Desheng Gate to meet Esen head-on.

s0088 ends 率副總兵范廣、武興陳德勝門外: 武興 is Wu Xing and 陳 is the verb 'array' before 德勝門; the old idiomatic invents Chen De, drops Wu Xing, and misses that Qian and Shi Heng led the vice commanders and arrayed outside Desheng Gate. The proposed wording matches the Chinese.

He urgently dispatched the various generals, leading an army of two hundred twenty thousand and arraying formations outside the nine gates: Military Commissioner Tao Jin at Anding Gate, Earl of Guangning Liu An at Dongzhi Gate, Baron of Wujin Zhu Ying at Chaoyang Gate, Military Commissioner Liu Ju at Xizhi Gate, Marquis of Zhenyuan Gu Xingzu at Fucheng Gate, Regional Commander Li Duan at Zhengyang Gate, Military Commissioner Liu Dexin at Chongwen Gate, Regional Commander Tang Jie at Xuanwu Gate, while Qian himself with Shi Heng led Vice Commanders-in-chief Fan Guang and Wu Xing Chen De outside Desheng Gate to face Esen.

He urgently dispatched the various generals, leading an army of two hundred twenty thousand and arraying formations outside the nine gates: Military Commissioner Tao Jin at Anding Gate, Earl of Guangning Liu An at Dongzhi Gate, Baron of Wujin Zhu Ying at Chaoyang Gate, Military Commissioner Liu Ju at Xizhi Gate, Marquis of Zhenyuan Gu Xingzu at Fucheng Gate, Regional Commander Li Duan at Zhengyang Gate, Military Commissioner Liu Dexin at Chongwen Gate, Regional Commander Tang Jie at Xuanwu Gate, while Qian himself with Shi Heng led Vice Commanders-in-chief Fan Guang and Wu Xing, arrayed outside Desheng Gate to face Esen.
The literal likewise fuses 武興 with a false name Chen De; 陳德勝門外 means arrayed outside Desheng Gate. The proposed literal correctly separates Wu Xing and restores the verb 陳.
More than two hundred thousand refugees from Shandong and Shaanxi had fled to Henan for food; Qian asked that grain reserves in Henan and Huaqing prefectures be opened for relief.
More than two hundred thousand refugees from Shandong and Shaanxi had fled to Henan for food; Qian asked that grain reserves in Henan and Huaiqing prefectures be opened for relief.
s0042 has 河南、懷慶二府; 懷慶 is Huaiqing Prefecture, not Huaqing. The proposed idiomatic corrects only that place name.

At the time over two hundred thousand refugees from Shandong and Shaanxi had come to Henan seeking food; Qian requested that accumulated grain in the two prefectures of Henan and Huaqing be released for relief.

At the time over two hundred thousand refugees from Shandong and Shaanxi had come to Henan seeking food; Qian requested that accumulated grain in the two prefectures of Henan and Huaiqing be released for relief.
The literal makes the same error: 懷慶 should be Huaiqing, not Huaqing. The proposed replacement is accurate.
Court lecturer Xu Xing said the heavens showed ominous signs and urged moving the capital south.
Court lecturer Xu Cheng said the heavens showed ominous signs and urged moving the capital south.
s0051 names 侍講徐珵; 珵 is read chéng, so Xu Cheng, not Xu Xing. The proposed idiomatic corrects the personal name only.
Court Lecturer Xu Xing said the stars showed change and that they should move the capital south.
Court Lecturer Xu Cheng said the stars showed change and that they should move the capital south.
The literal likewise misreads 徐珵 as Xu Xing; Xu Cheng is the correct reading, and the rest of the proposed sentence is unchanged and accurate.
A man who wears armor and yet shows such cowardice—how can he fight the enemy? By law he deserves death."
Gui, a minister who wears armor, yet shows such cowardice—how can he fight the enemy? By law he deserves death."
s0123 opens 貴為介胄臣, naming Gui (許貴 from prior context); the old idiomatic replaces that named address with a generic armored man. The proposed wording restores Gui.
When Yang Hong withdrew from Dushi to the capital, all eight border forts were abandoned to the enemy.
When Yang Hong entered the capital guard from Dushi, all eight cities were entirely left to the invaders.
s0158 has 楊洪自獨石入衛,八城悉以委寇: 入衛 means entering the capital guard, not withdrawing; the old idiomatic over-translates the verb. The proposed wording restores 入衛 and keeps 八城悉以委寇.
Through espionage he arranged the release of Batai's family, promising them titles if they would work against Esen from within.
Through espionage he arranged the release of Batai's family, promising them titles if they would plot secretly from within.
s0129 ends 使陰圖之 and does not name 也先; the old idiomatic invents an explicit Esen referent. The proposed wording keeps the secret-plotting sense without that invention.
Qian's nature was by nature rigid; when matters did not go as wished he would strike his chest and sigh: "This one cavity of hot blood—where does it intend to be spilled!"
By nature Qian was stern; when matters did not go as wished he would strike his chest and sigh: "This one cavity of hot blood—where does it intend to be spilled!"
s0191 謙性故剛 yields one inherent-temperament marker; the old literal doubles 'by nature' into ungrammatical English. The proposed literal removes the doubling while preserving the sigh quotation.
On bingxu the reign title was changed to Tianshun; on dinghai Qian was abandoned to the market, his household registered and confiscated, and his family exiled to the frontier.
On bingxu the reign title was changed to Tianshun; on dinghai Qian was executed in the marketplace, his household registered and confiscated, and his family exiled to the frontier.

s0214 棄謙市 is the standard marketplace execution formula 棄市; 'abandoned to the market' is a calque that obscures the death sentence. The proposed literal matches the idiomatic sense already used for this unit.
The ministry deliberation held to this and stopped.
Ministry deliberation resisted the proposal and stopped it.

After Wu Yu's extreme proposal, 部議持之而止 means the ministries held against it and stopped the matter; 'held to this and stopped' is opaque and can invert the sense. The proposed literal matches the blocking reading in the idiomatic.
The former emperor already knew his wrong, and Our heart truly pities his loyalty."
The former emperor already knew he was wronged, and Our heart truly pities his loyalty."
s0248 已知其枉 means the former emperor already knew Yu Qian was wronged (枉 = injustice), not that he 'knew his wrong.' The proposed literal restores that meaning.
In Hongzhi 2, on supervising secretary Sun Xu's recommendation, he was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Pillar of the State, and Grand Tutor, with the posthumous title Su Min.

In Hongzhi 2, on supervising secretary Sun Xu's recommendation, he was posthumously made Special Advancement Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Pillar of the State, and Grand Tutor, with the posthumous title Su Min.
s0250 grants 特進光祿大夫、柱國、太傅; the old idiomatic omits 特進 (Special Advancement). The proposed wording restores the full title string.
Mian, styled Jingzhan, inherited a vice company commandership but was exiled to Longmen when his father fell.
Mian, styled Jingzhan, received yin privilege as Vice Company Commander and by conviction was exiled to garrison at Longmen.
s0255 has 廕授副千戶，坐戍龍門 only: yin privilege as vice company commander and conviction to garrison exile at Longmen. The old idiomatic invents 'when his father fell,' which this unit does not say.
Under Zhengtong he rose twice to director in the Bureau of Appointments.
Under Zhengtong he rose twice to director in the Bureau of Operations.
s0264 職方郎中 is the Ming War Ministry Bureau of Operations (職方), not the Bureau of Appointments (文選). The proposed idiomatic corrects the bureau name.
In Zhengtong he was twice transferred to Bureau Director in the Bureau of Appointments.
In Zhengtong he was twice transferred to Bureau Director in the Bureau of Operations.
The literal likewise mistranslates 職方 as Bureau of Appointments; Bureau of Operations is correct.
He passed the jinshi in Zhengtong 1, entered the Hanlin Academy, and was made a director in the Ministry of Revenue.
He passed the jinshi in Zhengtong 1, was made a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed a director in the Ministry of Revenue.

Chapter text 改庶起士 is a corrupt form of 庶吉士 (Hanlin Bachelor), confirmed on Wikisource; 'entered the Hanlin Academy' is vaguer and less accurate than the appointment title. The proposed idiomatic matches the standard reading and the already-correct literal.
Qian brought him in as director in the Bureau of Appointments.
Qian brought him in as director in the Bureau of Operations.
s0285 職方司郎中 is again the Bureau of Operations, not Appointments. The proposed idiomatic corrects only that bureau name.
Qian brought him in as Bureau Director in the Bureau of Appointments.
Qian brought him in as Bureau Director in the Bureau of Operations.
The literal likewise mistranslates 職方司 as Bureau of Appointments; Bureau of Operations is the correct Ming War Ministry bureau.
